subtitle: Testing every change before it reaches production

code:
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["dbt/driftwood_analytics/**"]
jobs:
  dbt-test:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install dbt-snowflake
      - run: dbt build --target ci \
          --select state:modified+
